title: Settings
acctOutHint: Without signing in, Persist Notes opens in read-only mode for your meetings. Sign in to record, import, summarize, and ask.
keepAudio: Keep the audio (.wav) in an audio/ subfolder
systemAudio: Also capture the computer audio (participants on Teams, Meet, Zoom)
myVoiceHint: Lets the app recognize you in the computer audio. It stays on this computer only and never goes to Claude.
diarize: Separate the participants' voices (Person 1, Person 2…), on your computer
calendar: Calendar (to suggest the title and guest names)
calPlaceholder: Paste your calendar's iCal link here (one per line) or the path to an .ics file
calHelp: Google Calendar: Settings → your calendar → Secret address in iCal format. Outlook: Settings → Calendar → Shared calendars → Publish a calendar → ICS link. The link stays on this computer only.
voiceOffHint: Automatically recognizes, in upcoming meetings, the people you've already named. Uses voice prints stored on this computer only. Off by default.
liveHint: Transcription happens during the meeting, in the background and at low priority, so it doesn't get in the way of Teams, Meet, or Zoom. Fewer cores keep the call lighter; more cores get the note ready faster. Once the recording ends, the app uses all of them.
claudeHint: Uses your Claude subscription: install Claude Code and run claude once in the terminal to sign in. Persist Notes removes the ANTHROPIC_API_KEY variable when calling Claude, so you aren't charged for API usage.
mcpHint: Connects Persist Notes to Claude as a source: Claude can then search meetings, decisions, Commitments, and project syntheses. Read-only.
diarNoEngine: The voice separation component isn't available in this installation.
diarReady: All set: voices in the system audio are separated when transcribing.
diarNeeded: Needed to separate voices ({size}, one time only).
permNative: The computer's sound uses the System Audio Recording Only permission (Privacy & Security → Screen & System Audio Recording). If you open Persist Notes from the terminal (npm start), the terminal app (Terminal, iTerm, VS Code…) is the one that needs the permission.
permOld: On this macOS, the computer's sound requires the Screen & System Audio Recording permission. The system asks on the first recording.
needClaude: install and sign in to Claude Code (for summaries)
mcpCodeDone: ✓ Done. Open a new Claude Code session and ask about your meetings.
mcpDesktopDone: ✓ Configured in {file}. Quit and reopen Claude Desktop to turn it on.
calEmpty: Paste an iCal link or choose an .ics file first.
calOk: ✓ {count} events read · {next} in the next 7 days.
meetingDetect: Ask whether to record when a meeting starts
meetingDetectHint: Persist Notes notices when one of these apps starts using the microphone (the same signal that turns on the system's microphone indicator). Nothing is recorded unless you choose Record.
muteShortcutHint: The shortcuts work even with Persist Notes in the background, only while recording. Click the field and press the key combination.
micDeviceHint: If the chosen microphone isn’t connected, Persist Notes records with the system default and lets you know.
whisperBuiltin: Built into the app (whisper.cpp {version}). Nothing to install.
whisperSystem: Using the system whisper-cli ({path}) because the built-in one did not work on this computer.
meetingSound: Play a short sound when a meeting starts or ends
meetingAutoStop: End automatically after an unanswered end-of-meeting prompt
meetingAutoStopHint: Applies to recordings started from the meeting prompt. A recording you start yourself never stops on its own.
recordShortcutHint: {key} records the detected meeting and, while recording, ends it, from any app; {mark} marks the moment. Otherwise the shortcut stays free for other apps.
